text:
ashley: Short follow-up after the uploader postmortem. We need a tidy sprint to fix repeated pages: dedupe keys, threshold smoothing, and a paging policy that avoids waking oncall for noise. I'm listing owners + acceptance criteria below.

vik: I'll take the dedupe sweep and rule cleanup. Plan: replace `instance`-first grouping with `service:job:bucket:region:env:error_code`. Short suppression: 15s, rolling window 6m. I'll add unit tests and a small simulation script. ETA: Thu EOD. Ticket: INF-412.

mira: I'll own the query smoothing + historical replay. Proposal: use p95 over 6m with `for: 5m` and apply a rolling median filter to drop single-request spikes. I'll run a 7-day replay and produce a delta table. ETA: Mon. Ticket: INF-413.

tom: I'll update the paging policy + PD mapping. New policy: only page if (A) >=2 regions affected within 12m OR (B) same group fires >3 times in 12m. Add 18m per-responder backoff and a `no_page` opt-in label for known noisy flows. ETA: Fri noon. Ticket: OPS-229.

ashley: Good. Acceptance criteria for merges before rollout: 1) dedupe PR has tests + simulation (v1), 2) query change reduces pages on replay by >=50% for the noisy alerts set without increasing customer_error_rate by >3%, 3) paging policy updated and PD mapping validated in staging, 4) runbook updated with rollback steps + a post-deploy evaluation checklist.

vik: Draft group_key snippet I'll include in PR:
```
group_key: "{{service}}:{{job}}:{{bucket}}:{{region}}:{{env}}:{{error_code}}"
suppression: 15s
window: 6m
```

mira: Draft PromQL I'll test in replay: 
```
# p95 per job/region/env over 6m, require 5m sustained
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(uploader_request_duration_seconds_bucket[6m])) by (le, job, region, env)) > 1.2
for: 5m
```
I'll attach a CSV with pages/day and unique_incidents/day for the 7-day window.

tom: I'll add a PD rule that suppresses routing to human oncall unless criteria met, and wire `no_page=true` label to keep alerts visible but silent.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Alerts cleanup sprint sync" Wed 15:00 UTC in #eng-oncall. Reminder 20m prior.

ashley: Canary plan: route 20% of traffic to tuned alerts for 36h. Auto-revert conditions: pages_per_min_canary > control by 20% AND customer_error_rate_delta < 4% OR MTTACK doubles. We'll monitor dashboards and logs.

vik: I'll include a small sim harness in the PR so we can run quick checks on merge.

mira: For the replay acceptance I'll include: (a) per-alert violin plots, (b) TP/FP heuristics, (c) a short note on any alerts that degrade and why.

tom: After staging validation I'll request sign-off from OPS on the PD mapping.

ashley: Owners recap (confirm):
- Dedupe and simulation: vik  ETA Thu EOD (INF-412)
- Query smoothing + replay: mira  ETA Mon (INF-413)
- Paging policy + PD mapping: tom  ETA Fri noon (OPS-229)
- Sync & final sign-off: ashley to run Wed meeting

vik: confirmed.

mira: confirmed, will post CSV + graphs here.

tom: confirmed.

ashley: Great. Once PRs and replay artifacts are posted we'll run the 36h canary. Keep this thread updated with links to PRs/dashboards. We'll close when all acceptance criteria pass and the canary is green. :white_check_mark:
